claim: Each partition of an SQS FIFO queue is limited to 300 transactions per second for each API action (SendMessage, ReceiveMessage and DeleteMessage).
question: SQS FIFO throughput without high-throughput mode (transactions per second per API action)?

qualifiers.scope: per partition of a FIFO queue, per API action
qualifiers.condition: The page says this limit applies to non-high throughput mode; high throughput mode surpasses it.

note: The queue-types page says 300 API calls per second per API method for the whole queue; the quotas page says per partition. The quotas page is used as current truth.
